text:
maria.cs: kicking off the reserved pool liftoff sync for NimbusCorp — looking to confirm quota, autoscale thresholds, and the load-test window. available now for a quick check?
ow 09:02 owen-sre: I can join in 10. quick ask: do we use the warm-cache script or full cold priming?
maria.cs: prefer warm-cache for the first pass. we have 100k cached prefixes per model from their dry-run. cold priming later if smoke passes.
lee-customer: thanks — we validated prefix set yesterday, should be the same as the one in the ticket.
jess-product: outline from CS perspective: (1) quota allocation: 200k tokens/sec burst, 20k sustained; (2) autoscale policy: scale up at 70% CPU or 60% queue depth for 30s; scale down after 5m; (3) canary: 2 instances serving 10% traffic for 30m.
oven-sre: confirmed we provisioned the reserved pool: 6xA100-equivalents. initial reserved quota set to 250k token/sec burst on their org id. will hold the extra headroom for 48h.
vik-ml: note on quantization: we have a quantized variant ready (`gptx-4q2`) that drops cost ~30% but increases p95 by ~12ms. suggest we gate it behind canary.
sam-oncall: tagging oncall rotation: sam-oncall (me) primary, owen-sre backup, escalation to infra-leads after 15m. Slack channel #cs-nimbus-liftoff for live.
maria.cs: load test plan draft: warm-cache run 20m at 40% target rps, then ramp to 100% target rps over 15m, soak 30m. fallback: abort if error rate >1% or p95 > target+200ms for 3 consecutive minutes.
jess-product: add GA check: billing meter observation for reserved vs burst usage to verify no unexpected metering. tagging @finance in the doc.
lee-customer: can we run a targeted rerank subset during soak? those have higher latency. we want to validate fallbacks.
oven-sre: yes — we'll include a rerank traffic slice (10% of requests) hitting the higher sequence path. need their API keys for the test env. lee-customer: shared via secure link: https://redwood-secure/secret/xyz (expires in 2h)
maria.cs: load command for ops (copy/paste):
```
loadrunner --profile warm-cache --rps 1500 --duration 20m --targets model:gptx-4 --slice:rerank=10 --auth-file ./nimbus_test_key.json
```
deploy-bot: deployment started: reserved-pool-nimbus v1.2 — provisioning GPUs (6/6), network ok, kms handshake pending.
oven-sre: provisioning finished. KMS key accepted. starting warm-cache pass now.
(maria.cs adds reaction) :thumbsup:
10:47 vik-ml: quick heads-up — if we see p95 drift >40ms during ramp, prefer to roll back quantized variant and increase batch size instead.
sam-oncall: warm-cache pass complete — success metrics: error rate 0.06%, avg latency 82ms, p95 210ms. moving to ramp.
maria.cs: ramping to 100% now. monitoring dashboards: token throughput, p95, error rate, queue depth, and billing delta.
20:12 owen-sre: hitting 100% target. p95 creeping to 320ms on rerank slice. error rate 0.9%. watching.
lee-customer: rerank perf is the main customer concern — do we throttle rerank to 5% if it keeps rising?
jess-product: agreed, plan B: throttle rerank to 5% and broaden caching rules. notifying product/legal for change-in-behavior note.
oven-sre: initiated automated throttle for rerank -> 5%. keeping overall rps constant.
maria.cs: abort conditions not met, but keep an eye. can we run a quick fallback validation for degraded rerank path?
vik-ml: running fallback smoke now: calling fallback-model for 2k requests. sample looks good. minor semantic shift noticed in 0.8% of responses. logging for eval.
sam-oncall: soak window started. p95 stabilized at 240ms after throttle. error rate 0.4%.
maria.cs: great. next steps: (a) handover to account exec for renewal signal, (b) attach runbook and metrics to the ticket, (c) schedule 1-week post-activation healthcheck. I'll prepare notes.
lee-customer: we'll take it to internal ops and share feedback by EOD tomorrow. thanks team.
jess-product: capturing feedback, will follow up on quantized gating and rerank throttles in the roadmap.
deploy-bot: reserved-pool-nimbus v1.2 — load-test completed, status: succeeded. artifacts: /artifacts/nimbus/1813377777/logs.zip
maria.cs: excellent work. closing loop: please add any leftover action items to the ticket before EOD.
(ovens-sre typo fixed) owen-sre: noted — created follow-ups: #1 update canary policy, #2 billing metric alert, #3 rerank feature flag.
maria.cs: thanks everyone. landing summary will be posted in #customer-success and added to the customer onboarding doc.
